Problem:
What is the measure of the smaller angle between the hands of a 12-hour clock at 12:25 pm, in degrees? Express your answer as a decimal to the nearest tenth.

message.content:
At 12:25, the minute hand is at \(25 \times 6 = 150^\circ\).

The hour hand moves \(0.5^\circ\) per minute, so in 25 minutes it moves \(25 \times 0.5 = 12.5^\circ\).

The angle between them is \(150 - 12.5 = 137.5^\circ\). The smaller angle is \(360 - 137.5 = 222.5^\circ\)? No—137.5° is already less than 180°, so it is the smaller angle.

The answer is 137.5.
